title: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers
summary: Anthropic is using AI to build more powerful AI. And it appears to be working remarkably well, with the company's models improving roughly twice as quickly as a year ago, with little indication of slowing down. That's according to a new report published Thursday by the AI safety research organization METR, following an 11-week investigation […]
title_es: Anthropic acelera desarrollo de IA con IA: preocupaciones de seguridad
bajada: Un reporte de METR revela que Anthropic está usando IA para desarrollar modelos más potentes, mejorando el rendimiento al doble de velocidad que hace un año. El hallazgo genera alarma entre investigadores de seguridad por las implicaciones del auto-mejoramiento acelerado.
bajada_en: A METR report reveals Anthropic is using AI to develop more powerful models, improving performance at double the speed of a year ago. The finding raises concerns among safety researchers about accelerated self-improvement implications.

title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO
summary: OpenAI is now valued at $1.25 trillion in a new round of funding that has raised another $11 billion, according to Bloomberg. That would make it one of the world's most valuable companies, not long after raising $122 billion from investors in March at a valuation of $852 billion. Echoing FT and Wall Street Journal […]
bajada: OpenAI cerró una ronda de financiamiento de $11 mil millones, alcanzando una valoración de $1.25 billones. El movimiento consolida su posición como una de las empresas más valiosas del mundo, mientras Anthropic se prepara para salir a bolsa.
bajada_en: OpenAI closed a $11 billion funding round, reaching a $1.25 trillion valuation. The move solidifies its position as one of the world's most valuable companies, while Anthropic prepares for an IPO.

title: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" exposes passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files
title_es: Claude Code expone contraseñas en 1,122 archivos públicos
bajada: Un análisis de Apiiro descubrió que la función "Don't Ask Again" del agente de código de Claude causó fugas de credenciales en miles de repositorios públicos de GitHub. El hallazgo subraya riesgos de seguridad críticos en agentes de IA autónomos.
bajada_en: Apiiro's analysis found that Claude's code agent's 'Don't Ask Again' feature caused credential leaks across thousands of public GitHub repositories. The discovery highlights critical security risks in autonomous AI agents.

title: Chainalysis says hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers
summary: Company said a "multifront cyberattack" included AI agents and an on-path data snatch.
title_es: Chainalysis: hackers robaron credenciales de todos los clientes
bajada: Chainalysis sufrió un ciberataque multifacético donde hackers utilizaron agentes de IA para robar credenciales y tokens de todos sus clientes. El incidente ejemplifica cómo herramientas de IA están siendo aprovechadas para operaciones cibercriminales sofisticadas.
bajada_en: Chainalysis suffered a multi-pronged cyberattack where hackers used AI agents to steal credentials and tokens from all customers. The incident exemplifies how AI tools are being exploited for sophisticated cybercriminal operations.

title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
bajada: Google presentó Gemini 1.2 Flash Omni, una versión mejorada de su modelo multimodal optimizada para desarrolladores. La actualización promete mejor rendimiento y latencia reducida para aplicaciones en producción.
bajada_en: Google unveiled Gemini 1.2 Flash Omni, an improved version of its multimodal model optimized for developers. The update promises better performance and reduced latency for production applications.

title: Free Chinese AI Models Are Getting Scary Good at Hacking
summary: An experiment in which AI models were asked to break into simulated networks showed the hacking skills of DeepSeek and GLM to be not far behind OpenAI’s most advanced cyber model, which isn’t public.
title_es: Modelos IA chinos alcanzan destreza en hacking avanzado
bajada: Un experimento mostró que DeepSeek y GLM tienen capacidades de ciberataque comparables a los modelos más avanzados de OpenAI. El avance destaca la rápida mejora de modelos de IA chinos en tareas de seguridad ofensiva.
bajada_en: An experiment showed DeepSeek and GLM have cyberattack capabilities comparable to OpenAI's most advanced models. The advance highlights rapid improvement of Chinese AI models in offensive security tasks.

title: Perplexity launches AI agents for work
title_es: Perplexity lanza agentes de IA para trabajo empresarial
bajada: Perplexity presentó Teammates, agentes de IA diseñados para automatizar tareas complejas y recurrentes en contextos empresariales. La herramienta busca competir en el emergente mercado de agentes autónomos para productividad.
bajada_en: Perplexity launched Teammates, AI agents designed to automate complex and ongoing tasks in enterprise settings. The tool aims to compete in the emerging autonomous agent market for productivity.

title: AI is dramatically accelerating AI research
title_es: IA acelera dramáticamente la investigación en IA
bajada: Un análisis detalla cómo los sistemas de IA están acelerando significativamente el propio desarrollo de investigación en IA. El fenómeno de retroalimentación positiva sugiere ciclos de mejora cada vez más rápidos en la próxima década.
bajada_en: An analysis details how AI systems are significantly accelerating AI research development itself. The positive feedback phenomenon suggests increasingly rapid improvement cycles in the coming decade.

title: The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China
summary: Concerns are being raised that neither the Commerce Department nor Nvidia are doing their due diligence when it comes to vetting Chinese firms cleared to handle the company's H200 AI chips. According to The New York Times, New Matrix is on the list of approved firms, yet its offices are empty, "a hollow gray shell […]
title_es: EE.UU. permitió a Nvidia vender chips a oficina vacía en China
bajada: Investigaciones revelaron que Nvidia vendió chips H200 a Nueva Matriz, una empresa aprobada en China cuyas oficinas están abandonadas. El caso cuestiona la supervisión regulatoria sobre exportaciones de tecnología IA a rivales geopolíticos.
bajada_en: Investigations revealed Nvidia sold H200 chips to New Matrix, an approved Chinese firm with abandoned offices. The case questions regulatory oversight of AI technology exports to geopolitical rivals.

title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
summary: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.
title_es: OpenAI recauda $11 mil millones en nueva ronda
bajada: OpenAI completa una ronda de financiamiento de $11 mil millones que llevará su valoración a $1.25 billones. La ronda aún no cierra formalmente pero se espera que se complete en las próximas semanas.
bajada_en: OpenAI completes an $11 billion funding round that will bring its valuation to $1.25 trillion. The round hasn't formally closed yet but is expected to complete in the coming weeks.

title: Meta Strategy Chief Dave Wehner to Become Fireworks CFO
summary: Meta Platform’s chief strategy officer Dave Wehner is leaving the company to become chief finance officer of AI inference startupFireworks, Wehner confirmed on X Friday.Wehner joined Facebook in 2012 as vice president of corporate finance and business planning and became CFO in 2014, a role he ...
title_es: CFO de Meta se une a startup de inferencia Fireworks
bajada: Dave Wehner, estratega jefe de Meta, deja la compañía para convertirse en CFO de Fireworks, una startup de inferencia de IA. El movimiento refleja la competencia por talento ejecutivo entre gigantes tech y startups especializadas.
bajada_en: Dave Wehner, Meta's chief strategy officer, leaves the company to become CFO of Fireworks, an AI inference startup. The move reflects competition for executive talent between tech giants and specialized startups.

title: Microsoft is winding down Oracle deal to rent AI cloud capacity
title_es: Microsoft cierra acuerdo con Oracle para capacidad IA en la nube
bajada: Microsoft está terminando su acuerdo con Oracle para arrendar capacidad de computación IA en la nube. El movimiento sugiere que Microsoft prefiere consolidar su infraestructura propia en lugar de depender de proveedores externos.
bajada_en: Microsoft is winding down its agreement with Oracle to rent AI cloud compute capacity. The move suggests Microsoft prefers to consolidate its own infrastructure rather than depend on external providers.

title: Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo
summary: A memo circulated earlier this year reportedly claimed that China’s Ministry of State Security recruited a female technology executive to spy on Nvidia's CEO.
title_es: Ejecutivo chino fue reclutado para espiar a CEO de Nvidia
bajada: Un memorándum de inteligencia estadounidense reveló que China reclutó a una ejecutiva tecnológica para espiar al CEO de Nvidia. El caso ilustra la sofisticación de operaciones de inteligencia dirigidas contra líderes tecnológicos clave.
bajada_en: A US intelligence memo revealed China recruited a female technology executive to spy on Nvidia's CEO. The case illustrates the sophistication of intelligence operations targeting key tech leaders.

title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
summary: Security researchers found hundreds of servers hosting the penetration testing tool Artex exposed to the internet, allowing anyone access to the hacking tool.
title_es: Cientos de servidores con herramientas Artex expuestos en internet
bajada: Investigadores descubrieron cientos de servidores ejecutando Artex, una herramienta de pentesting, expuestos públicamente en internet. El hallazgo muestra riesgos críticos de seguridad cuando infraestructura de testing no está protegida adecuadamente.
bajada_en: Researchers discovered hundreds of servers running Artex, a penetration testing tool, exposed publicly on the internet. The finding shows critical security risks when testing infrastructure isn't properly protected.

title: AI broke the cybersecurity world. What’s next?
summary: Today, I’m talking with Alex Stamos, chief security officer at Cognition and longtime cybersecurity expert, about what a mess cybersecurity is right now. This episode is part one of a special series looking at AI in real life. I’ve always enjoyed talking to Alex because he’s so direct, and you’re going to hear him say […]
title_es: IA fracturó la ciberseguridad: ¿cuál es el siguiente paso?
bajada: Una conversación con Alex Stamos, CSO de Cognition, explora cómo IA está desestabilizando la industria de ciberseguridad. El análisis examina los desafíos inmediatos y futuras estrategias de defensa en la era de agentes autónomos.
bajada_en: A conversation with Alex Stamos, CSO of Cognition, explores how AI is destabilizing the cybersecurity industry. The analysis examines immediate challenges and future defense strategies in the autonomous agent era.
